build: Modwerk's linker (scripts/link-image.mjs): the Modwerk base's send-bus variant (0cdf0343, sdk/machines/analog-rytm-mkii/base-binding.json) + this folder's WAVEFOLDER 0.1.0-experimental package (3b5621c0), against the owner's stock OS 1.74, --version WF01
conditions: Cold boot, then dtboot WF01.syx --instr 7500M --every 1000M --press NO@2003M:12M --press NO@2303M:12M --press NO@2603M:12M --press NO@2903M:12M --press AMP@4003M:12M --press AMP@4603M:12M --press FX@5503M:12M --press SRC@6103M:12M --press SRC@6703M:12M, with DTBOOT_STEPS=1 and DTBOOT_PNG_DIR. On the FX track the SRC key opens DELAY, and each press there switches between DELAY and SEND FX. Frames are dtboot's firmware-rendered 128x64 screen at 3x, unmodified.
